description: Mapa del Grafo de Carreteras de la DGC is a dataset listed in IDEE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by gencat.cat. Publication of a map of the Catalonia road network, with the Milestones. Coverage: ES. The portal shows the English title as "DGC Roads Graph Map" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Segmentació Dinàmica, Eix, Administració, Sistema Referència Lineal, Transports, Navegació. The listing shows 2012-10-01 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-idee.
